create_volume_mount: create a Volume dataclass to mount a model, dataset, bucket, or space into a container with a specified path
build_space_runtime: build a SpaceRuntime dataclass from API response dict containing stage, hardware, sleep time, and volumes
search_spaces_results: search HuggingFace Spaces and return SpaceSearchResult objects with runtime, AI descriptions, and trending scores
manage_space_secrets: manage SpaceSecret dataclass entries with write-only keys, descriptions, and update timestamps
configure_space_variables: configure SpaceVariable dataclass entries with key-value pairs, descriptions, and update timestamps
